_about: Environment Kit (vertical slice, docs/art/vertical_slice.md). One entry per kit asset ID of the designer's sheet (tab 'Environment Kit'): where it plugs in ('slot'), what stands in for it until the painted art arrives ('placeholder': 'tex:<TEX name>' from assets/art/textures, or 'gen:<name>' generated in code by KitTextures), its tint, tile size in metres (tileable surfaces), and the sheet's description. Drop the real art in assets/art/env_kit/<ID>.webp (or .png) and EnvKit uses it by itself; nothing else changes. 'suggested' entries are not on the sheet yet (ids proposed in docs/art/vertical_slice.md).
